mapper.sql: SELECT shipment_id, shipment_no, order_id, order_no, contract_id, contract_no, customer_id, customer_name, status, shipment_date, logistics_company, tracking_no, total_qty, total_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, shipper_id, shipper_name, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM mk_shipment
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_shipment ( shipment_no, order_id, order_no, contract_id, contract_no, customer_id, customer_name, status, shipment_date, logistics_company, tracking_no, total_qty, total_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, shipper_id, shipper_name, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{shipmentNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{contractId}, #{contractNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{status}, #{shipmentDate}, #{logisticsCompany}, #{trackingNo}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{shipperId}, #{shipperName}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE mk_shipment SET del_flag = '2' WHERE shipment_id IN #{shipmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, shipment_id, order_item_id, product_name, product_spec, unit, ship_qty, unit_price, amount, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM mk_shipment_detail WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY detail_id ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE mk_shipment_detail SET del_flag = '2' WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_shipment SET status = #{status}, shipment_date = #{shipmentDate}, logistics_company = #{logisticsCompany}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, shipper_id = #{shipperId}, shipper_name = #{shipperName}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
UPDATE mk_shipment SET status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM mk_shipment WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('0', '1') AND order_id IS NOT NULL
